maddeler.e:
أتعاطف (form VI)
# أَتَعَاطَفُ (ʔataʕāṭafu) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.tˤa.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَعَاطَفَ (taʕāṭafa)
# أَتَعَاطَفَ (ʔataʕāṭafa) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.tˤa.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاطَفَ (taʕāṭafa)
# أَتَعَاطَفْ (ʔataʕāṭaf) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.tˤaf/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَعَاطَفَ (taʕāṭafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
